project_metadata.description: A cohesive domain model synthesized from bounded context analyses for an e-commerce system.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages customer profiles, their personal information, addresses, and wishlists.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: Represents a registered user of the system, holding personal and contact information.

entities.name: Address
entities.description: Represents a physical location associated with a customer, such as shipping or billing addresses.

entities.name: Wishlist
entities.description: A collection of products saved by a customer for future consideration.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages product definitions, their attributes, images, specifications, and categorization.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: A distinct item offered for sale, identified by a unique SKU and described by various attributes.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: A classification for organizing products into hierarchical groups.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary value with a specific currency.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles the lifecycle of customer orders, from creation to fulfillment, including order items and pricing.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A record of a customer's request to purchase products, including details like total amount, status, and addresses.

entities.name: OrderItem
entities.description: A specific product and its quantity included within an order.

value_objects.name: OrderStatus
value_objects.description: The current state or stage of an order in its lifecycle.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary value with a specific currency.

value_objects.name: Address
value_objects.description: A snapshot of a physical address used for shipping or billing within a specific order.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages stock levels for products across warehouses, ensuring availability and preventing overselling.

entities.name: StockLevel
entities.description: Represents the quantity of a specific product available or reserved in a particular warehouse.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages payment transactions, processing, refunds, and customer's saved payment methods.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A record of a financial transaction made to fulfill an order.

entities.name: SavedPaymentMethod
entities.description: A customer's stored payment instrument for future use.

value_objects.name: PaymentMethodInfo
value_objects.description: Details of a payment method, typically masked for security.

value_objects.name: PaymentStatus
value_objects.description: The current state of a payment transaction.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary value with a specific currency.
